title: 29West lbmsrs protocol changes through UM 6.17 release.
description:
lbmsrs: the following messages are being added.

SRI - SRS Route Information message added, provides route information into
local domain

SRE - SRS Route End message added, provides notification that route is no
longer available

DMI - SRS Domain Information message added, provides notification of domains
available to local domain

CNI - SRS Context Name Information, provides domain ID, IP address, and port
for name context

CNQ - SRS Context Name Query, request for Information on a given context name

CNE - SRS Context Name End, notification that a given named context mapping is
now invalid

Includes some compiler warning cleanups for global and local names being identical.

Hi Sherwin,

Can you attach some pcap ? do you have fuzz the code ?

can look the following minor warning

```
 epan/dissectors/packet-lbmsrs.c 2122 / 2472 "If set, context names are filetered" filetered  ->  ?

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-lbmsrs.c:3474 proto_tree_add_item called for hf_lbmsrs_reg_resp_protocol_version  -  item type is FT_UINT8 but call has len 4
```

I can attach the pcap that I am testing with and I will filter it to just be the LBMSRS channel.

I will check the warning.  That variable did change in size and I must have missed part of the update.

What is "fuzz" the code?

We did do fuzz testing on input into our product many years back. It is not something that we have readily available at this point.  In this case, the LBMSRS protocol runs on top of an rsocket layer, so we would be looking at randomized data in a valid rsocket format.

I will advocate for this testing with our product team, I would expect that to include the dissector as well.

commits_data.message:
29West lbmsrs protocol changes through UM 6.17 release.

lbmsrs: the following messages are being added.

SRI - SRS Route Information message added, provides route information into
local domain

SRE - SRS Route End message added, provides notification that route is no
longer available

DMI - SRS Domain Information message added, provides notification of domains
available to local domain

CNI - SRS Context Name Information, provides domain ID, IP address, and port
for name context

CNQ - SRS Context Name Query, request for Information on a given context name

CNE - SRS Context Name End, notification that a given named context mapping is
now invalid

The pipeline for merge request reported illegal APIs. I updated all references to
strncat() to strncat_s(); and g_snprintf() to snprintf() and retested that
dissection still works as expected. However, strncat_s() is only valid on Windows.
The logic using strncat_s() in the sub-element counter for SRS messages was
then replaced with logic that keeps track of the offset within the final string to be
displayed and snprintf() for each non-zero counter.

Typo in visible text for "context interest filtering".  That interest is
"filtered" not "filetered".

Fix mismatch in length of hf_lbmsrs_reg_resp_protocol_version.
L_LBM_SRS_REGISTRATION_RESPONSE_INFO_T_PROTOCOL_VERSION should be 1, not 4.
L_LBM_SRS_REGISTRATION_RESPONSE_INFO_T_LOCAL_DOMAIN_ID should be 4, not 1
